english: Augustine Manasseh has won the 2023 Golden Classic PGA Golf Tournament.

twi: Wei ne nea edi kan a wanya trophy wɔ golf akansie mu.
english: This is his first trophy in a golf competition.

twi: Wɔ nna mmiɛnsa a akansie no kɔe no wanya score a ɛyɛ 173.
english: Over the three days the competition lasted he achieved a score of 173.

twi: Wei yɛ nkonimdie a ɛyɛ nwanwa paa ma ɔbarima yi.
english: This is a truly remarkable victory for this man.

twi: Wɔ afa foforo nso Archbishop Nicholas DuncanWilliams a ɔyɛ Action Chapel International fapemfo aka ne suahu a ɛyɛ hu bi fa ne junior pastor bi a wakɔ ne nkra ho.
english: On another note Archbishop Nicholas DuncanWilliams founder of Action Chapel International shared a chilling experience regarding one of his junior pastors who had betrayed him.

twi: Archbishop kae sɛ saa pastor yi guu no adane kɛse.
english: The Archbishop said that this pastor had deceived him greatly.

twi: Ɔkaa sɛ mma ɔbarima yi abusua no nnkɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ obewu a na sɛ wɔkɔ a ɛbɛyɛ wɔn bɔne.
english: He advised the mans family not to go near him if he were to die as doing so would bring them misfortune.

twi: Wei de amaneɛbɔ foforo baa asɛm no so.
english: This added a new dimension to the issue.

twi: Sɛ yɛhwɛ August Manasseh nkonimdie no a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abɔden wɔ hɔ ma ɔmanfo yi sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma yiye.
english: Looking at Augustine Manassehs victory it shows that there is potential for these citizens to do well.

twi: Nanso Archbishop asɛm no nso ma yɛhu sɛ nkurɔfo bɔne yɛ ade a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ yiye.
english: However the Archbishops words also show that we must be careful of wicked people.

twi: Ɛyɛ abakɔsɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nsɛm pii rekɔ so wɔ Ghana.
english: It is a reflection of the fact that many things are happening in Ghana.

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛma ɔman yi rekɔ so yɛn nsam.
english: We should not let this country slip through our fingers.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ adwene wɔ nneɛma a ɛho hia so.
english: We must focus on things that matter.

twi: Ɛnɛ yɛn man yi mu nsɛm yɛ dɔm paa na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn nyinaa hwɛ yiye.
english: Today our national affairs are complex and we all need to be careful.

twi: Yɛmma yɛn adwene nnyina ɔman no yiyedie so.
english: Let us base our thinking on the countrys wellbeing.

twi: Ghana wɔ nkwa nanso ɛhĩa sɛ yɛhwɛ sɛnea yɛbɛfa kwan pa so.
english: Ghana is alive but we need to ensure we take the right path.

twi: Charles Mensa aka no ana?
english: Charles Mensa said?

twi: Ɔka sɛ yɛsan rekɔ IMF bio!
english: He says we are going back to the IMF again!

twi: Wei nyɛ asɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ yɛn nwanwa koraa Kofi.
english: This shouldnt surprise us at all Kofi.

twi: Sɛ ɔman no nni nhyehyɛe pa a dɛn na ɛbɛba?
english: If the country has no good plan what else would happen?

twi: Nanso 18th time?
english: But for the 18th time?

twi: Wei yɛ animguase paa!
english: That is very shameful!

twi: Yɛwɔ sika yɛwɔ nneɛma pii nanso daa yɛkɔ srɛ sika.
english: We have money we have many resources but we are always begging for money.

twi: Sika nko ara nni hɔ mmom nneyɛe no ne asɛm no.
english: It is not just about a lack of money the real issue is our actions.

twi: Wunim sɛ August Manasseh adi nkonim wɔ golf mu no?
english: Did you know that Augustine Manasseh won in golf?

twi: Ɛhɔ nso yɛ anigye nanso nnipa bɔne nso wɔ hɔ.
english: That is a joy but there are bad people out there too.

twi: Awurade ma Archbishop DuncanWilliams asɛm no nso.
english: Lord even consider Archbishop DuncanWilliamss statement.

twi: Wotee sɛnea ɔrekasa faa nakyi pastor no ho ana?
english: Did you hear how he spoke about his former pastor?

twi: Ɛyɛ hu!
english: Its scary!

twi: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ yɛn asetra mu yi sɛ wunni ahwɛyiye a wankasa mpo bɛgu wo adane.
english: It shows that in our life today if you are not careful even your own people will betray you.

twi: Ɛyɛ nokware.
english: It is true.

twi: Nanso me adwene ne sɛ dɛn na yɛbɛyɛ ama Ghana asakra?
english: But my thought is what are we going to do to make Ghana change?

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛkɔ so yɛ nneɛma koro no ara.
english: We shouldnt keep doing the same things.

twi: Structural reforms no na ɛho hia.
english: Structural reforms are what is needed.

twi: Sɛ yɛnsakra no a 18th time no bɛba pɛpɛɛpɛ.
english: If we dont change them the 18th time will definitely happen.

twi: Nanso amanfo no nni adwene sɛ wɔbesakra.
english: But the people dont think they will change.

twi: Wɔn nyinaa pɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nea wɔpɛ na ɔman no bɛyɛ dɛn?
english: They all want to do what they want and what will become of the nation?

twi: Ɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ awerɛho.
english: These are sad things.

twi: Wunim sɛ yɛn anigye ne yɛn ahohyia nyinaa wɔ yɛn nsam.
english: You know our joy and our hardships are both in our own hands.

twi: Mpo ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn nyinaa kanyan.
english: Besides we all need to be awakened.

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛkɔ so te hɔ nko ara.
english: We shouldnt keep sitting there.

twi: Yɛn nneyɛe na ɛbɛkyerɛ nea ɔman yi rekɔ.
english: Our actions will determine where this country is heading.

twi: Waka nea ɛyɛ nokware.
english: You have said what is true.

twi: Mma yɛn nni adwene sɛ yɛn nyinaa nni heni bi.
english: Lets not think we dont have anywhere to go.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ nea yɛbɛyɛ.
english: We must look at what we will do.

twi: Ampa.
english: Yes.

twi: Archbishop no nso ne asɛm no yɛ kɔkɔbɔ kɛse.
english: And the Archbishop his words are a great warning.

twi: Yɛnhwɛ yiye.
english: We should be careful.

twi: Yɛnkɔ so mmra nea ɛfata.
english: Let us continue to do what is appropriate.

twi: Na tete bere bi wɔ ɔman bi mu na ɔhene bi wɔ hɔ.
english: In times past in a certain nation there was a king.

twi: Saa ɔhene yi wɔ sika ne adwuma pii nanso na ɔnni nhyehyɛe biara.
english: This king had money and many workers but he had no plan at all.

twi: Ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Ananse baa hɔ bɛkae sɛ Nana sɛ wunni nhyehyɛe a wo sika bɛyera.
english: A man named Ananse came there and said Nana if you have no plan your money will be lost.

twi: Ɔhene no annye nni.
english: The king did not believe him.

twi: Da koro ɔhene no kɔɔ ne nsam na onyaa nea ɛbɛyɛ no hu.
english: One day the king was left on his own and he faced what he feared.

twi: Wɔkae sɛ Wose sɛ wo sika bɛyera na ɛbae.
english: They said You said your money would be lost and it happened.

twi: Ɔhene no kɔɔ amanɔne kɔsrɛɛ sika nanso saa na ɛkɔɔ so.
english: The king went abroad to borrow money but that is how it kept going.

twi: Ananse nso dii nkonim wɔ akansie bi mu na onyaa adepa nanso na ɔhene no da so rekɔsrɛ sika.
english: Ananse also won a competition and gained good things but the king continued to beg for money.

twi: Wɔbɛkaa abakɔsɛm yi sɛ Sɛ wunni wankasa nhyehyɛe a obiara nnye wo.
english: People would say of this history If you have no plan of your own no one will believe you.

twi: Archbishop bi nso baa hɔ bɛkyerɛɛ sɛ nipa bɔne nni ntam.
english: An Archbishop also came and showed that there is no neutrality when it comes to wicked people.

twi: Ɛyɛ anansesɛm nanso ɛkyerɛ nokware.
english: It is a folktale but it shows the truth.

twi: Ghana yi ɛte sɛ saa ɔhene yi.
english: This Ghana is like that king.

twi: Yɛwɔ sika yɛwɔ nneɛma nanso sɛ yɛnni nhyehyɛe a yɛbɛsan akɔ IMF.
english: We have money we have resources but if we have no plan we will return to the IMF.

twi: Sɛ yɛne yɛn nsam yɛ adwuma yiye a ɛbɛyɛ yiye.
english: If we do our own work well it will go well.

twi: Nanso yɛnni ahwɛyiye a yɛbɛgu adane.
english: But if we are not careful we will be betrayed.

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛma ɔbarima bɔne gu yɛn adane.
english: We must not let wicked men betray us.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn nyinaa kanyan na yɛyɛ nea ɛfata ma yɛn man.
english: We must all wake up and do what is appropriate for our nation.

twi: Ananse kaa sɛ Adwene ne ahwɛyiye na ɛma ɔman kɔ anim.
english: Ananse said Thought and vigilance are what make a nation move forward.

twi: Ɛnɛ yɛn nyinaa hwɛ yɛn nyinaa tie na yɛn nyinaa yɛ.
english: Today let us all watch let us all listen and let us all act.

twi: Ghana nnyina nnyina nanso sɛ yɛyɛ nea ɛfata a ɛbɛyɛ yiye.
english: Ghana is not standing firm but if we do what is appropriate it will go well.

twi: Archbishop no kɔkɔbɔ no yɛ aduru nanso ɛhĩa sɛ yɛnya akokoduru.
english: The Archbishops warning is medicine but we need courage.

twi: Ɛnɛ yɛn nyinaa nnyina na yɛka.
english: Today let us all stand up and speak.

twi: Sɛ yɛkɔ so yɛ nneɛma a ɛfata a yɛbɛnya Ghana a yɛn nyinaa pɛ.
english: If we continue to do what is appropriate we will get the Ghana that we all want.

twi: Nanso sɛ yɛkɔ so srɛ sika a yɛbɛkɔ daa.
english: But if we continue to beg for money we will go on forever.

twi: Mma yɛnni adwene sɛ yɛn nni heni.
english: Let us not think we have nowhere to go.

twi: Yɛn nyinaa ne Ghana.
english: We are all Ghana.

twi: Mma yɛn nni adwene sɛ yɛn nni heni nanso yɛn nyinaa nnyina yɛn nan so.
english: Let us not think we have nowhere to go but we must all stand on our own feet.

twi: Ɛyɛ bere a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ adwuma.
english: It is time for us to work.

twi: Me tirim yɛ me nwanwa pa ara bere a mehunu nea ɛrekɔ so wɔ yɛn man mu ha.
english: I am truly amazed when I see what is happening in our country.

twi: Sɛ mehwɛ Tema nkyɛn hɔ no mani gye bere a mete sɛ Korea Maritime Institute ne Ghana Fisheries Commission rehyɛ nneɛma ase ma yɛn mmea a wɔyɛ edwuma wɔ mpataayi mu no.
english: When I look toward Tema I am happy to hear that the Korea Maritime Institute and the Ghana Fisheries Commission are initiating things for our women who work in fishing.

twi: Wɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma den ara de kyerɛɛm sɛ wɔn nsa bɛka mmoa a ɛbɛma wɔn edwuma no ayɛ yiye no ɛyɛ anigyesɛm.
english: Those who work hard to receive support to improve their work is good news.

twi: Ɛfata sɛ yɛhyɛ mmea den efisɛ wɔne abusua ahotoso.
english: It is appropriate that we empower women because they are the trust of the family.

twi: Nanso bere a yɛn mmea rekɔ anim no me werɛ aho bere a mema me ani so hwɛ ɔman no sikasɛm mu nsɛm.
english: However as our women are moving forward I am saddened when I raise my eyes to look at the countrys economic issues.

twi: Ɔmanpanin Nana AkufoAddo ka sɛ IMF deal no bɛsan de anidaso aba nanso ɛnyɛ adwene a obiara pɛ sɛ ɔgye di.
english: President Nana AkufoAddo says the IMF deal will bring hope again but it is not an idea that everyone wants to believe.

twi: Merekasa yi ɛnyɛ sɛ merepɛ sɛ mehyɛ obiaa abufuo nanso yɛn nyinaa nim sɛ ɛkwan a ɛda yɛn anim no yɛ tenten.
english: As I speak it is not that I want to anger anyone but we all know the path ahead of us is long.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn manfoɔ hu sɛ sikasɛm mu gyinapɛn no mfa adwuma nni ho mmara ɛho hia sɛ anigyede ne adwumayɛ pa ka ho.
english: Our citizens must understand that economic standards do not work without rules it requires joy and good work as well.

twi: Mepɛ sɛ mihunu sɛ yɛn mmea a wɔwɔ Tema no nya wɔn ho na ɛnyɛ nnaadaa nko na yɛde ka wɔn ho.
english: I want to see our women in Tema prosper and not just be deceived.

twi: Sɛ yɛhwɛ yɛn man yi yie a yɛbɛhu sɛ yɛwɔ ahoɔden nanso ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ yiye sɛnea yɛde yɛn sika ne yɛn nnwuma di dwuma.
english: If we look at our nation well we will see that we have strength but we must be careful how we use our money and our jobs.

twi: Me pɛ sɛ meto nsa frɛ ananmusifoɔ ne adwumakuo nyinaa sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma a ɛwɔ nokware na ɛnyɛ nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ adwene nko.
english: I want to call on representatives and all companies to work with integrity not just words that only express thoughts.

twi: Momma yɛn mmea nni nkonim na yɛn man nso nnya nkɔsoɔ.
english: Let our women win and let our nation also progress.

twi: Ɔbɛnem bosome no anɔpa bi a ɛyɛ fɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ Tema mpataayi beaeɛ hɔ no hunuui sɛ adwumakuo foforo reba.
english: In the month of March on a beautiful morning those at the Tema fishing site saw a new company arriving.

twi: Korea Maritime Institute ne Ghana Fisheries Commission ayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wɔbɛkyekye nneɛma foforo ama mmea a wɔdɔn pataa na wɔtɔn.
english: The Korea Maritime Institute and the Ghana Fisheries Commission have made plans to build new things for the women who smoke and sell fish.

twi: Eyi yɛ adwuma kɛse pa ara efisɛ ɛbɛma wɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma no nya mfiridwuma foforo ne nneɛma a ɛbɛma wɔn adwuma no ayɛ ntɛm.
english: This is a very great work because it will allow those who work to have new technology and materials that will make their work faster.

twi: Wɔde nkrataa abɛsi hɔ sɛ obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔn adwumayɛ no mfa ne nhyehyɛeɛ mma.
english: They have put up notices so that anyone who wants to help their work should submit their plan.

twi: Ɔmanpanin Nana AkufoAddo nso aka asɛm bi wɔ ne nsrahwɛ mu faa IMF ho.
english: President Nana AkufoAddo has also spoken about the IMF during his visit.

twi: Ɛyɛ anigyesɛm sɛ ɔman no renyan nanso ɛhia sɛ ɛkwan a wɔfa so no yɛ nea obiara bɛtumi de ne ho ato so.
english: It is good news that the country is waking up but it is necessary that the path they take is one that everyone can rely on.

twi: Afei nso ɛfata sɛ yɛkae nnansa yi bi ɛno ne berɛ a Ghana dii nkonim wɔ aquatic sports mu wɔ Burma Camp.
english: Also it is appropriate that we remember something from recent days which is the time Ghana won in aquatic sports at Burma Camp.

twi: Ɛyɛ afe 2022 November bosome ɛda a ɛtɔ so nnum.
english: It was November 5 2022.

twi: Ɛhɔ na yɛn mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔman yi mu kyerɛɛ wɔn ahoɔden wɔ nsuo mu.
english: That is where our youth in this nation showed their strength in the water.

twi: Sport yɛ adeɛ a ɛka yɛn bom na aquatic sports no kyerɛɛ sɛ yɛwɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ nipadua mu ahoɔden.
english: Sport is something that brings us together and the aquatic sports showed that we have young men and women who have physical strength.

twi: Sɛ yɛhwɛ Tema adwuma no ne Burma Camp agodie no a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Ghana wɔ nkɔsoɔ.
english: If we look at the Tema work and the Burma Camp games it shows that Ghana is making progress.

twi: Ɛhia sɛ yɛtoa so hwehwɛ akwan a yɛbɛfa so ama yɛn manfoɔ nnya dwumadie.
english: It is necessary that we continue to look for ways to help our people have employment.

twi: Mensah wotee asɛm a ɔmanpanin kae no faa IMF ne yɛn sikasɛm ho no anaa?
english: Mensah did you hear what the President said about the IMF and our economy?

twi: Me tee Kofi.
english: I heard Kofi.

twi: Nanso me deɛ me nni gyidi koraa.
english: But as for me I have no faith at all.

twi: Wokeka IMF ho asɛm yi a ɛma me werɛ how efisɛ yɛadi kan aka saa nnyinasoɔ yi deda.
english: Whenever you mention the IMF it saddens me because we have already been down this road before.

twi: Wei deɛ ɛyɛ nanso hwɛ adwuma a Korea Maritime Institute ne Fisheries Commission reyɛ wɔ Tema.
english: That may be so but look at the work the Korea Maritime Institute and Fisheries Commission are doing in Tema.

twi: Tema adwuma no yɛ papa nanso mepɛ sɛ mihunu sɛ wɔde nneɛma no bedi dwuma yie.
english: The work in Tema is good but I want to see that the resources are used well.

twi: Mmea a wɔwɔ hɔ no hia mmoa ankasa ɛnyɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ.
english: The women there really need support not just empty words.

twi: Ɛyɛ nokware.
english: Thats true.

twi: Nanso woanka sɛ aquatic sports a yɛyɛeɛ wɔ Burma Camp no na ɛkyerɛ sɛ yɛwɔ ahoɔden?
english: But havent you said that the aquatic sports we held at Burma Camp showed our strength?

twi: Ɛhɔ na yɛhunuu sɛ yɛn mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa betumi ayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ.
english: Thats where we saw that our young men and women could achieve great things.

twi: Ɛhɔ deɛ mani gyee ho paa!
english: About that I was very pleased!

twi: Ghana ansa na ɛwɔ sport a ɛtete saa nanso ɔman no mufoɔ daa wɔn ahoɔden adi.
english: Ghana has never had sports like that but the citizens showed their strength.

twi: Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a ɛkyerɛ sɛ yɛwɔ tumi nanso ɛhia sɛ yɛyɛ nneɛma no firi yɛn koma mu.
english: If we put it all together it means we have the power but we need to do things from the heart.

twi: Me ne wo nni nsɛm pii nanso me gyidi ne sɛ sɛ yɛyɛ yɛn adwuma yie a yɛbɛdi nkonim.
english: I dont disagree with you much but my belief is that if we do our work well we will succeed.

twi: Nokware nanso momma yɛhwɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ adwuma no mu nni nnaadaa.
english: True but lets make sure that those who get involved in the work are not corrupt.

twi: Tete kan ɔkraman ne ɔpatuo tenaa ase sɛ wɔrebɛyɛ adwuma bi wɔ nsuo ho.
english: Once upon a time a dog and an owl sat down to do some work by the water.

twi: Ɛno ne bere a Ananse hunuu sɛ mmea wɔ Tema hɔ a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma na wɔbɛtumi ayɛ pii nanso na wɔn nsa nka nneɛma a ɛfata.
english: That was the time Ananse saw that there were women in Tema who wanted to work and could do much but lacked the proper resources.

twi: Ananse a onim adwene dodo baa wɔn nkyɛn bɛka sɛ Mmea mo nsa bɛka mmoa a ɛbɛma mo adwuma ayɛ kɛse!
english: Ananse who is full of wisdom approached them and said Women your hands will get the help that will make your work significant!

twi: Ɛno na ɛmaa aquatic sports no baa yɛn man mu efisɛ Ananse daa no adi sɛ sɛ woamfa wo nipadua nyɛ adwuma a wo nsa nka nkonimdie.
english: That is what brought aquatic sports to our country because Ananse showed that if you dont use your body to work you wont gain success.

twi: Ɔkraman no hyɛɛ nsuo no ase ɔpatuo nso bɔɔ nkokoraa nanso na Ananse rekyerɛ wɔn sɛ sikasɛm te sɛ nsuo.
english: The dog went into the water and the owl hooted but Ananse was showing them that the economy is like water.

twi: Sɛ ɛkɔ so a ɛba nanso sɛ woamfa akwantu pa nni dwuma a ɛbɛforo akɔ.
english: If it keeps going it comes but if you dont manage the journey well it will rise away.

twi: Ɛno nti na nnɛ mmea a wɔwɔ Tema hɔ de akwantu a Korea ne Ghana abom ayɛ no rehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn adwuma.
english: That is why today the women in Tema are using the journey that Korea and Ghana have come together to make to ensure they do their work.

twi: Ɛno nti na wɔn a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn nsa wɔ saa adwuma no mu nyinaa hia nhyehyɛeɛ.
english: That is why everyone who will put their hands to work in that endeavor needs a plan.

twi: Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ Ananse nsa bɛka adwuma no bi nanso ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn mmea no hu sɛ wonni wɔn ho a ɛrenkyɛ na nsuo no afi ase asesa.
english: It is likely Ananses hands will touch some of the work but our women must realize that if they dont take charge it wont be long before the water starts to change.

twi: Ghana wɔ nsuo ne fam nanso sɛ yɛamfa yɛn nsa nni dwuma yie a yɛbɛtena hɔ a nneɛma rensesa.
english: Ghana has water and land but if we dont use our hands well we will just sit there and things wont change.

twi: Ɛno na Ananse kyerɛɛ yɛn wɔ asase yi so sɛ obiara a ɔpɛ nkɔsoɔ no ɛhia sɛ ɔfa ne nsa yɛ adwuma.
english: That is what Ananse taught us on this earth that anyone who wants progress needs to work with their hands.

twi: Ɛnyɛ nsɛm kwa nanso ɛyɛ akwantu a ɛwɔ nyansa sɛnea yɛn mmea ne yɛn mmeranteɛ reyɛ.
english: Its not just talk but a wise journey just like our women and youth are doing.

twi: Me tirim yɛ me duru dodo bere a metie nsɛm a ɛfa Ghana ananmusini a ɛwɔ China ho yi.
english: I am very heavyhearted when I hear news concerning the Ghanaian embassy in China.

twi: Ɛyɛ me ya sɛ obi te sɛ Haruna Iddrisu Minority Leader no bɛba abɛka asɛm yi adi.
english: It saddens me that someone like Haruna Iddrisu the Minority Leader has to come and address this issue.

twi: Sɛ ɔman yi bɛyɛ adwuma yiye a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛdi yɛn nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ amanɔne no ho dwuma yiye.
english: If this country is to function properly we must take good care of our people who are abroad.

twi: Coronavirus no nti ɔhaw a ɛwɔ China no yɛ den dodo.
english: Because of the coronavirus the distress in China is too severe.

twi: Me nte aseɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a embassy no nni sika a ɛfata sɛ wɔde boa yɛn nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no.
english: I dont understand how the embassy can lack the adequate funds to help our people who are there.

twi: Ɛyɛ aniwuo sɛ Ghana bɛda nkwa mu na aban no nni nhyehyɛɛ biara a ɛyɛ den ma yɛn nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ China.
english: It is shameful that Ghana will prioritize saving lives while the government has no concrete plan for our people in China.

twi: Ɛwɔ sɛ yɛgyina hɔ kyerɛ yɛn nkurɔfoɔ sɛ yɛdwen wɔn ho.
english: We ought to stand by our people to show that we care about them.

twi: Yɛn amanfoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no wɔwɔ abusua wɔ ha na wɔn ho bɛyɛ wɔn dwoodwoo nti ɛsɛ sɛ aban no de sika ma embassy no sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi ayɛ adwuma no yiye.
english: Our people there have families here and for their peace of mind the government should provide money to the embassy so they can do their work properly.

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛgyina aban nko ara so nanso ɛyɛ adwuma a ɛhia dodo.
english: We shouldnt rely solely on the government but this is a very urgent task.

twi: Ɛduru me koma mu dodo na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwɛ yɛn nkurɔfoɔ yiye.
english: It weighs heavily on my heart and we must look after our people well.

twi: Gold Fields PGA Golden Classic Championship no aba akɔ duru nsubontene no mu.
english: The Gold Fields PGA Golden Classic Championship has arrived in the heart of the action.

twi: Wɔ 19th kosii 21st March 2020 no golfers a wɔwɔ Ghana nyinaa bɛboaboa wɔn ho ano ama saa akansie kɛseɛ yi.
english: From the 19th to the 21st of March 2020 all golfers in Ghana will gather for this major competition.

twi: Lucas Ribeiro Costa nso nasɛm no yɛ nea ɛyɛ nwonwa.
english: The case of Lucas Ribeiro Costa is also remarkable.

twi: Ɔne Mamelodi Sundowns a ɛwɔ South Africa no aso no deɛ ɛnni hɔ bio.
english: His association with Mamelodi Sundowns in South Africa is no more.

twi: Ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ footballer a odi kan a ɔbɛtumi anya mfasoɔ afiri Lassana Diarra ne FIFA asɛm no mu.
english: He wants to be the first footballer who can benefit from the Lassana Diarra and FIFA ruling.

twi: Saa football nsɛm yi na ɛkɔ so no ɛkyerɛ sɛ amanɔne agodie nso asakra koraa.
english: The fact that these football issues are occurring shows that international sports have also changed completely.

twi: Ghana sport nso deɛ yɛkɔ anim kakra nanso ɛhia sɛ yɛbɔ ho ban.
english: As for Ghana sports we are progressing a little but we need to protect it.

twi: Ghana Golfers nso kyerɛ sɛ wɔwɔ ahoɔden na saa Golden Classic yi bɛyɛ nea ɛbɛma sport no akɔ anim koraa wɔ ɔman no mu.
english: Ghana golfers also show that they have strength and this Golden Classic will be something that will move the sport forward significantly in the country.

twi: Mmate kakra bi nanso ɛyɛ asɛm a ɛhia dodo.
english: Ive heard a little but it is a very important issue.

twi: Sɛ ɔman no nni sika a ɛboa yɛn nkurɔfoɔ wɔ amanɔne a ɛne sɛ yɛn ho nni mfasoɔ biara.
english: If the country doesnt have money to help our people abroad it means we are of no value.

twi: Nokware no ni.
english: That is the truth.

twi: Nanso woahwɛ Ghana golf akansie a ɛkɔ so wɔ Damang no?
english: But have you looked at the Ghana golf tournament taking place in Damang?

twi: Ɛhɔ na ɛyɛ anigyeɛ nso.
english: That is where there is some excitement as well.

twi: Daabi memmɛn hɔ koraa.
english: No Im nowhere near there.

twi: Ɛno deɛ ɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛkɔ so wɔ wiase no nyinaa.
english: Well those are things happening all over the world.

twi: Football ne politics na ɛdi nneɛma anim.
english: Football and politics lead the way.

twi: Sɛ wote asɛm a ɛfa Lassana Diarra ne FIFA ho a wubehu sɛ ɛno na ɛreyɛ nneɛma biara.
english: If you hear the news about Lassana Diarra and FIFA you will see that that is what is influencing everything.

twi: Nanso yɛn nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ China no deɛ wɔn ho nsɛm yɛ me ya.
english: But as for our people in China their situation pains me.

twi: Me nso medwene saa ara.
english: I feel the same way.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ sika no ntɛm ara ma wɔn.
english: They need to secure the money for them immediately.

twi: Ghana mma no hia boa.
english: The children of Ghana need support.

twi: Sɛ Ghana Golf Championship no deɛ yɛn nkurɔfoɔ akɔ sɔre na ɛno bɛma nkurɔfoɔ anya adwuma bi ayɛ.
english: As for the Ghana Golf Championship our people have risen up and that will give people some work to do.

twi: Ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ nwonwa sɛ yɛbɛtumi de nneɛma bebree akɔ anim.
english: It is amazing that we can push many things forward.

twi: Ananse nyaa adwene sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔ dwadie wɔ China nanso ansa na ɔbɛfiri hɔ no ɔbɛhwehwɛ sika bi.
english: Ananse had an idea to go do business in China but before he left he needed some money.

twi: Ɔkɔkaa sɛ Sɛ mehyɛ akwantuo a ɛsɛ sɛ meboa me nkurɔfoɔ.
english: He said If I am embarking on a journey I must help my people.

twi: Ananse bɛyɛɛ nea ɔdwen nkurɔfoɔ ho nanso na ɔdwen ne ho nko ara.
english: Ananse acted like he cared about others but he was only looking out for himself.

twi: Ɔkɔkaa asɛm kyerɛɛ asɛm bi a ɛyɛ nwonwa.
english: He spoke about something amazing.

twi: Ɔbɛgyina Damang Golf course hɔ na ɔreto golf no.
english: He stood at the Damang Golf course playing golf.

twi: Ɔkae sɛ Sɛ mɛdi nkonim wɔ golf yi mu a mɛnya sika amoa China nkurɔfoɔ no.
english: He said If I win this golf match I will get the money to empty the Chinese people.

twi: Nanso berɛ a ɔreto golf no ɔwɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔbɛdi FIFA nkonim wɔ ne Lucas Ribeiro Costa asɛm no mu.
english: But while he was playing golf he had it in his mind to win FIFA in his Lucas Ribeiro Costa matter.

twi: Ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ nwonwa sɛdeɛ Ananse bɛtumi ayɛ saa nneɛma yi nyinaa.
english: It is amazing how Ananse could do all these things.

twi: Ɔkɔɔ asɛm bi mu na ɔde ne nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ anuanom bɔɔ ne ho ban.
english: He got involved in a matter and he protected himself with his cunning behavior.

twi: Ɛwɔ sɛ yɛnya Ananse akyiri yi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a yɛn nkurɔfoɔ bɛnya mfasoɔ wɔ ɔman yi mu.
english: We must learn from Ananse later on so that our people can benefit in this nation.

twi: Ghanafoɔ mma munnye di sɛ Ananse nneyɛɛ no yɛ dɛ nanso ɛwɔ mfasoɔ nso.
english: People of Ghana believe that Ananses actions are sweet but they are also useful.

twi: Ɛyɛ anansesɛm a ɛwɔ nokware sɛdeɛ yɛbɛtumi ayɛ nneɛma yiye na yɛanya yɛn nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ amanɔne no mfasoɔ.
english: It is a folktale that holds truth how we can do things well and gain benefits for our people who are abroad.

twi: Mekyerɛ mo nokwareɛ ɛnnɛ me yam ye me dɛn?
english: I tell you the truth how do I feel today?

twi: Wayne Rooney a yɛn nyinaa nim no sɛ ɔyɛ legend wɔ bɔɔlbɔ wiase no afei wakɔyɛ pundit wɔ BBC?
english: Wayne Rooney whom we all know as a legend in the football world has now gone to become a pundit on the BBC?

twi: Ɛnnɛ nso hwɛ nsɛm a ɛrekɔ so wɔ Tyreek Hill ne ne yere Keeta Vaccaro ntam no.
english: Today too look at the issues going on between Tyreek Hill and his wife Keeta Vaccaro.

twi: Sɛ woyɛ superstar a wani nna fie a ɛha a wobehu no yɛ duru.
english: If you are a superstar and your mind isnt home the weight you will feel is heavy.

twi: Ɛno nti mepɛ sɛ mekae yɛn ha mmeranteɛ sɛ momma yɛn nso yɛn adwene nnyina fam.
english: That is why I want to remind our youth here let us also keep our feet on the ground.

twi: Ɛnyɛ bɔɔl nkoaa na ɛhia ɛhia sɛ wote wani na wuhu nea ɛkɔ so wɔ wasetena mu.
english: It is not just football that matters you must keep your eyes open and see what is going on in your life.

twi: Ɛnnɛ wiase no nneɛma ntra hɔ ma obiara.
english: In todays world things dont stay the same for anyone.

twi: Sɛ woyɛ bɔɔlbɔni anaa obi a wo din agye ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ nwanwa wɔ nea woyɛ biara mu.
english: If you are a footballer or someone whose name has become famous you must be careful in everything you do.

twi: Me kra mu no mepɛ sɛ mekae sɛ ɛnnɛ sɛ obi ankasa annya ne ho a ebi bɛkɔ.
english: In my soul I want to say that today if one does not secure themselves something will happen.

twi: Na Mohammed Salisu nso?
english: And what about Mohammed Salisu?

twi: Ɛyɛ me yaw sɛ AS Monaco rema no kwan.
english: It pains me that AS Monaco is letting him go.

twi: Wiase yi sɛ wo ho nni mu a obiara nni hɔ bɛkyerɛ wo kwan.
english: In this world if you dont secure yourself no one will be there to show you the way.

twi: Ɛno nti mmeranteɛ momma yɛn hyɛ yɛn ho nkuran sɛ yɛnyɛ yie.
english: That is why youth let us encourage ourselves to do well.

twi: Rooney Hill Salisuwɔn nyinaa ne yɛn asetenam nsɛm a ɛrekɔ so no nyinaa kyerɛ me sɛ asetenam ɛyɛ awo ne ɛbɔ.
english: Rooney Hill Salisuall of them and our life issues happening show me that life is full of ups and downs.

twi: Obiara wɔ ne kwan a ɔfa so.
english: Everyone has a path they follow.

twi: Sɛ yɛhwɛ Salisu a ɔbɛkyerɛ ne tumi wɔ baabi foforɔ.
english: If we look at Salisu he will show his power elsewhere.

twi: Sɛ yɛhwɛ Rooney a ɔkɔfa ne nyansa akɔtena BBC studio.
english: If we look at Rooney he has taken his wisdom to sit in the BBC studio.

twi: Tyreek Hill nso a ne ho nsɛm bɛkɔ so.
english: Tyreek Hill too his issues will continue.

twi: Ɛnnɛ me nteaseɛ ne sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛpa yɛn abaw.
english: My understanding today is that we should not give up.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkura yɛn ani wɔ nea yɛreyɛ biara mu.
english: We must keep our eyes on whatever we are doing.

twi: Na ɛtwaa hɔ no ananse pii ne ne nyansa bɛkaa nsɛm bi.
english: And finally Ananse and his wisdom spoke about some matters.

twi: Ɛwɔ tete no na ɔhene bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ akokoduru ne sika bebree sɛnea Rooney wɔ bɔɔlbɔ wiase no.
english: In ancient times there was a king who had courage and plenty of money just like Rooney in the football world.

twi: Ɔhene no ho nsɛm nso kɔɔ kɔɔt sɛnea Tyreek Hill rekɔtua sika no.
english: The kings own matters went to court just like the money Tyreek Hill is paying.

twi: Ananse kyerɛɛ sɛ Ɛmfa ho wo din ne wo tumi sɛ woabɔ wo ho na woannyɛ yie a wo sika bɛyɛ furaa.
english: Ananse said Regardless of your name and your power if you have not protected yourself and you do not do well your money will become little.

twi: Na Mohammed Salisu nso wɔ hɔ sɛ abarimaa a ɔkɔɔ akwantuo nanso ɔhene no team no amfa no anim akyerɛ no.
english: And Mohammed Salisu was also there as a young man who went on a journey but the kings team did not show him favor.

twi: Ananse bɛkaa sɛ Sɛ wɔyi wo afiri wo fie a ɛnyɛ awieiɛ ɛyɛ kwan foforɔ a wuda adi.
english: Ananse spoke up saying If you are removed from your home it is not the end it is a new path that you are showing.

twi: Ɛno nti wiase nneɛma no nyinaa te sɛ bɔɔlbɔ agorɔ baabi a wodi nkonim baabi nso a wodi nkuguo.
english: That is why all the things in the world are like a football match there are places where you win and there are places where you lose.

twi: Ananse kyerɛ yɛn sɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛ nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so wɔ yɛn asetenam.
english: Ananse shows us that we are all part of the things going on in our lives.

twi: Ananse nsɛm no ɛnyɛ nsɛm a yɛde di agorɔ nkoaa ɛyɛ nsɛm a yɛde sua nyansa.
english: Ananses words are not words we just play with they are words we use to learn wisdom.

twi: Sɛ wote Rooney anaa Salisu nsɛm no ase a hu sɛ wiase yɛ baabi a wobɛtumi atu mpɔn.
english: If you understand the Rooney or Salisu matters know that the world is a place where you can succeed.

twi: Ɛno nti yɛn nyinaa ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ anansesɛm a ɛbɛkyerɛ yɛn kwan.
english: That is why we must all make folktales that will show us the way.

twi: Yɛn ntie ananse ne nyansa na yɛnhwɛ sɛ yɛbɛkura yɛn ho yie wɔ wiase a ɛrekɔ so yi mu.
english: Let us listen to Ananse and wisdom and let us see to it that we take care of ourselves in this world that is moving along.

twi: Saa na ɛteɛ wiase no yɛ agorɔ na yɛn nyinaa yɛ agordiefoɔ.
english: That is how it is the world is a game and we are all players.

twi: Ɛyɛ me ya paa sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ sɛ obi bɛhyɛ adwuma ase no yɛ den na nea ɛyɛ den koraa ne sɛnea wode bɛkura na woama aka sɛ biribiara rekɔ so yiye.
english: It really pains me how hard it is to start a venture and the hardest part is sustaining it to ensure everything continues well.

twi: Me nuanom obiara nnye nni sɛ adwumayɛ yɛ akwantu a ɛwɔ nsuo ne mmepɔw nanso sɛ yenni nhyehyɛe pa a ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛanya nkɔsoɔ?
english: My brothers and sisters no one denies that work is a journey filled with obstacles but if we dont have good plans how will we make progress?

twi: Mepɛ sɛ mekae me nuanom a wɔwɔ Lower Manya Krobo hɔ wɔn a wɔwɔ akwahosan mu nkwa nti wɔfrɛ wɔn Persons Living With Disabilities no.
english: I want to address my brothers and sisters in Lower Manya Krobo those who are referred to as Persons Living With Disabilities due to their health conditions.

twi: Ɛyɛ me ya sɛ mehu sɛ wɔrekɔ akwantu a ɛyɛ duru yi wɔn nko ara.
english: It pains me to see them going through this difficult journey all alone.

twi: Wɔrekɔ hwehwɛ mmoa sɛ wɔn mfa nhyehyɛe bi a ɛbɛma wɔn kwan afa so asua nneyɛe ahorow.
english: They are seeking help to access programs that will allow them to learn various skills.

twi: Ɛyɛ aniwuo sɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ tumi ne wɔn a wɔwɔ sika bɛtena wɔn nkongua so ahwɛ deɛ ɛrekɔ so no.
english: It is shameful to see those with power and money sitting on their hands watching what is unfolding.

twi: Hwan na ɔbɛka sɛ saa nkurɔfoɔ yi nni nkwa?
english: Who would say these people dont have lives?

twi: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotete adwuma a ehia sɛ wobɛnya baabi a wotena baabi a wosua adwuma ne baabi a wunya akwahosan hwɛ.
english: If you want to start a venture you need a place to stay a place to learn the craft and a place to get healthcare.

twi: Nanso wɔ Lower Manya Krobo no asɛm no yɛ duru.
english: But in Lower Manya Krobo the situation is dire.

twi: Me nkwa mu amaneɛ yi meka sɛ sɛ yɛpɛ ɔman yi nkɔsoɔ a gyae nneyɛe a ɛte sɛɛ.
english: In my own lifes struggle I say if we want this nation to progress we must stop such behavior.

twi: Ɛnyɛ nkurɔfoɔ na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn adwuma nanso nhyehyɛe no mfa wɔn nsa.
english: It is not that people dont want to do their work but the system does not give them a hand.

twi: Mepɛ sɛ meka kyerɛ aban ne atetesɛm no sɛ momma yɛn nuanom yi mmɔbɔ.
english: I want to tell the government and traditional authorities to have mercy on our brothers and sisters.

twi: Wonim biribi a ɛyɛ me ya nso?
english: You know something else that pains me?

twi: Ɛyɛ saa asɛm a Rev.
english: Its the matter that Rev.

twi: Lawrence Tetteh no kaa wɔ Legon no.
english: Lawrence Tetteh spoke about at Legon.

twi: Ɛyɛ amapa sɛ wodi mfomsoɔ a wobɛkɔ akɔpae mu aka sɛ meka no fɔm.
english: It is honorable to make a mistake and come out to say I was wrong.

twi: Nanso ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhu sɛ nneɛma a yɛka no wɔ nkwa mu no wɔ ho nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛse.
english: But we must realize that the things we say in life have major consequences.

twi: Sɛ woka asɛm bi a ɛfa HIV ho wɔ sukuupɔn kɛseɛ bi ho a ɛnyɛ asɛm ketewa.
english: If you make a statement regarding HIV at a large university it is not a small matter.

twi: Nanso sɛ ɔno ankasa firi ne pɛ mu kɔpɛɛ nkwa kwan sɛ ɔbɛsrɛ bɔne mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obuo wɔ hɔ.
english: But if the person himself willingly seeks a way of life to ask for forgiveness it shows there is respect.

twi: Yɛnhwɛ mma yɛn nneyɛe nnyina asɛm a ɛbɛsɛe obi din.
english: Let us not let our actions be based on words that destroy someones reputation.
